metrics_purpose: CP2 와 별개 dialogue capability + brain-anchor consistency 측정. Stage 1-2 prototype 평가 mandatory.

metrics.name: response coherence
metrics.instrumentation: BERTScore (Llama-3.2-3B reference) + ROUGE-L vs prior turn
metrics.why_this_threshold: Llama-3.2-3B baseline conversation 의 typical range
metrics.stage_2_target: M1_stage2 > M1_stage1 + 0.05 (CLM substrate 활용 시 향상)

metrics.name: brain state consistency
metrics.instrumentation: BOLD pattern stability across turns: vertex-wise Pearson r between consecutive turn BOLD predictions
metrics.why_this_threshold: TRIBE v2 일반 generalization 대비 dialogue context 누적 효과 측정
metrics.stage_2_target: PASS (CLM tension 변화 trace 와 cross-validate)

metrics.name: user perception alignment
metrics.why_this_threshold: 자연 진화 path 의 사용자 reaction 이 evolution 방향 결정
metrics.stage_2_target: M3_stage2 > M3_stage1 + 1.0 (CLM substrate 시 anima identity 강화)

metrics.name: anima-specific identity
metrics.instrumentation: CLM mind.tension trace per turn: tension delta + nexus_psi_epsilon_R24 evidence (closure trace)
metrics.threshold_pass: tension delta nonzero per dialogue turn, R24 closure preserved (no rupture)
metrics.why_this_threshold: Stage 2 only (CLM 통합 후) — anima 의 hexa-native identity 가 dialogue 에 trace

metrics.name: novelty
metrics.instrumentation: response token n-gram (n=4) overlap vs Llama-3.2-3B training distribution proxy (Wikipedia + CC) + CLM training corpus
metrics.why_this_threshold: BOLD conditioning 의 novelty injection 효과 측정

evaluation_cadence: session 끝마다 M1-M5 batch 계산, weekly aggregate
